items.title: How much team output does an hour of coaching/unblocking actually buy?
items.description: Out of a 40-hour week, a manager splits time between personally doing IC work and enabling the team (unblocking, coaching, clarifying priorities) — the same trade-off Maya and Path A/B's manager face. Enabling hours have diminishing but real returns: the first few hours (clearing an obvious blocker) matter a lot, later hours matter less. Drag hours spent enabling the team and watch the modeled extra output produced across the whole team, not just by the manager.

params.name: enablingHoursPerWeek
params.label: Hours/week spent enabling the team (vs. personal IC work)

items.compute: const perPersonBoostPercent = Math.min(40, Math.sqrt(params.enablingHoursPerWeek) * 6); const totalTeamGainHours = Math.round((perPersonBoostPercent / 100) * 40 * params.teamSize); return { totalTeamGainHours };

outputs.label: Extra output produced across the team
